title: cscc remote access controls
linkedin:
> No.

Control 2-2-1-1 prohibits remote access to critical systems from outside the Kingdom. Control 2-2-1-2 allows access from inside the Kingdom but requires it to be restricted, with each access attempt verified by the organisation's security operations centre and remote access activity continuously monitored. Multi-factor authentication is required for all users (2-2-1-3) and for privileged users on the systems used to manage critical systems (2-2-1-4).
